Game Overview

Diner in the Storm is a adventure title where brave the storm and unravel the mystery behind the diner’s walls. With tension mounting and threats lurking, engage in strategic problem-solving to persuade fellow diners to escape. Can you gather the courage and teamwork needed to navigate the unknown and ensure everyone’s survival?
